commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The main referee, Ermano Feliciani, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Jacobo Ramon (Como) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+4' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
90+4' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) works the corner short.

90+3' A snap shot by Leon Bailey (AS Roma) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Jean Butez produces a good save to thwart him. The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' A pass into space is latched onto by Stefan Posch (Como), and he bends a shot just wide of the right post that had the keeper worried.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The foul by Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ermano Feliciani.
88' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Ermano Feliciani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
84' Stefan Posch (Como) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
83' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
82' Here comes a substitution. Matias Soule is given a rest as he is replaced by Leon Bailey (AS Roma).
79' The referee signals a substitution. Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Smolcic.
79' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) replacing Martin Baturina.
75' Martin Baturina (Como) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
73' Lorenzo Pellegrini goes off the pitch and Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) comes on.
71' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
65' Here is a change. Maxence Caqueret is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Stefan Posch (Como).
65' Jayden Addai comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
64' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) unleashes a shot, but it just misses the right-hand post.
61' 1 - 0 Wesley Franca (AS Roma) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
59' Nico Paz (Como) receives a yellow card for infringement.
58' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is shown a yellow card by the referee for dissent.
55' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Jayden Addai (Como), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.
54' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Como will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' A quickly taken corner by Como.

53' Nico Paz (Como) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
53' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Evan Ferguson (AS Roma), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
52' Cesc Fabregas appears to have said too much and referee Ermano Feliciani comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
51' Matias Soule (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' A goal, which was scored by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma), was disallowed due to offside.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Ermano Feliciani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Martin Baturina (Como) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
45+2' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Evan Ndicka (AS Roma), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in.
42' The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
41' What a great touch by Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
40' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Jean Butez comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' Nico Paz (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' Nico Paz (Como) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
38' Jayden Addai (Como) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make a change. Assane Diao is unable to continue due to injury, Anastasios Douvikas (Como) comes on.
36' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ermano Feliciani saw the whole situation.
34' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
34' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
32' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) picks up an injury.
31' Assane Diao (Como) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
30' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

30' That's unlucky! Matias Soule (AS Roma) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
29' Matias Soule (AS Roma) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
28' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AS Roma.
26' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
25' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
24' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.
24' Matias Soule (AS Roma) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
22' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
18' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Nico Paz (Como) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
12' The linesman signals that Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
9' Matias Soule (AS Roma) commits a foul and Ermano Feliciani immediately signals a free kick.
7' Maxence Caqueret (Como) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
4' Matias Soule (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Maxence Caqueret (Como) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ermano Feliciani.
